verdict.rationale: Sketch documents an official JavaScript plugin API with browsable classes and methods and a runnable "Hello Sketch" sample. It also offers skpm for publishing plugins and updates, and community reports describe a robust plugin ecosystem. Nothing in the evidence shows TypeScript typings or type definitions, which the story names explicitly, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented typings/type definitions, and a sample gallery beyond the single hello-world snippet.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented plugin API with typings and samples lets me build and distribute my own editor extensions

citations.quote: Write a Sketch plugin in JavaScript. Take advantage of ES6, access macOS frameworks and use the Sketch APIs without learning Objective-C or Swift.
An official vanilla JavaScript API, fully supported between releases. Browse all classes and methods, or drop down to the internal API when needed.
The code below shows a message at the bottom of your Sketch Document window saying _Hello Sketch 👋_.
Use the Sketch Plugin Manager `skpm` to publish a new plugin or an update of an existing one.
